testimonial: Working with Hannah was one of the best decisions we made during our daughter’s first year. We had a low sleep needs baby who seemed determined to prove every sleep “rule” wrong. By 8 months old, we were exhausted, discouraged, and worried that longer stretches of sleep just weren’t possible for her.

What made this experience so different was Hannah’s incredibly gentle, responsive, and individualized approach. I was not (and will never) be prepared to take the normalised advice of leaving babe to cry it out so Hannah was a ligh in the dark for us. There was never any pressure to force our baby into a schedule that didn’t fit her temperament or needs. Instead, she took the time to truly understand our child, our family, and our goals, then created a plan that felt realistic, respectful, and achievable. I’d followed Hannah for months and there was so much free info that was so valuable but it was her intuitive small tweaks that really gave the great differences.

Throughout the process, she was patient, encouraging, and endlessly reassuring. On the hard days, she reminded us of how far we’d come. On the good days, she celebrated every small win alongside us. Most importantly, she helped us build healthy sleep habits without compromising the loving, responsive parenting style that was so important to us.

Between 8 months and 1 year old, we saw remarkable progress. Our daughter gradually began sleeping longer stretches, got rid of a very very strong false start, she was settling more easily for me and hubb and getting the restorative sleep she needed.

The impact went far beyond sleep. Having more predictable nights gave our whole family more energy, patience, and joy. As a very active sporting person Hannah pretty much gave me “me” back but helping us with baby’s sleep!

If you’re struggling with a baby who doesn’t fit the typical sleep mold—especially a low sleep needs child—I cannot recommend Hannah highly enough. She is a wizard. Her expertise, compassion, and gentle guidance changed our lives, and we will always be grateful for the support she gave us during such an important season of parenthood. ❤️❤️❤️❤️
